summary: Find all ancestors of a node
description: Given a fixed edge list and a target node, return every node that directly or transitively calls the target.
scope: Use a tiny in-memory chain A -> B -> C
Do not include the target itself
acceptanceCriteria: ancestors(edges, 'B') for A->B and B->C returns A only, not C.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add UI, watcher, or CLI code unless this task explicitly requires it.
Do not compute a highlight set.

subtasks.title: Return transitive callers

businessRules: Return a set or sorted unique ids.
